dedupe_keys.name: season access metro reference network topology

description: SEASON Access-Metro Reference Network Topology is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors José Manuel Rivas Moscoso, Marco Quagliotti (Telefónica Innovación Digital (Spain)). We present a metro-regional network topology inspired by real topologies designed by the Telefónica group and four realistic access network topology geotypes prepared by Telecom Italia within the SEASON project. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
